tasks.name: Density of states
tasks.description: scf, then a denser nscf pass, then dos.x -- three steps sharing one prefix/outdir (v2 epic 9, #9).

tasks.name: Ionic relaxation
tasks.description: One pw.x run, calculation='relax': scf plus BFGS/damped/FIRE ionic-position optimization (v2 epic 10, #10).

tasks.name: Variable-cell relaxation
tasks.description: One pw.x run, calculation='vc-relax': scf plus BFGS ionic and cell relaxation together (v2 epic 10, #10).

facts.description: Whether the structure is metallic, from composition alone.
Whether the structure is expected to be magnetic.
Whether spin-orbit coupling is likely relevant for this structure.
Whether a Hubbard +U (or hybrid) correction is likely needed.

settings.description: Exchange-correlation functional label (e.g. PBE, PBEsol).
Pin an explicit pseudopotential table id instead of automatic selection.
Plane-wave wavefunction kinetic-energy cutoff.
Charge-density cutoff; auto-derived from ecutwfc_ry if unset.
Total valence electron count; otherwise summed from pseudopotential z_valence.
Force spin-polarized (nspin=2) vs non-spin-polarized calculation.
Enable noncollinear spin-orbit-coupling mode (always opt-in, never auto-enabled).
Total per-cell magnetization target; not valid together with spin_orbit_coupling.
Per-element starting spin-polarization fraction (each value in [-1, 1]) fed directly to the generated input, bypassing the valence-electron-based heuristic.
Opt in to a compensated antiferromagnetic ordering search ('afm') instead of the ferromagnetic default ('fm' or unset); degrades to ferromagnetic with a warning if no ordering can be found.
Force whether a van der Waals dispersion correction is applied.
Dispersion-correction method when use_vdw is set (only d3bj is implemented).
Force whether a Hubbard +U correction is applied, overriding even a human-set needs_correlation fact -- see the analysis-layer needs_correlation fact for the general judgement this escalates past.
Explicit Dudarev effective-U value per element, overriding the built-in table.
Force the electrostatic boundary-condition treatment for a periodic cell (e.g. 'martyna-tuckerman' for an isolated molecule/wire); 'none' for the normal fully-periodic case.
Electronic-occupation scheme (fixed, smearing, or tetrahedra_opt).
Smearing function used when occupations=smearing; defaults to 'cold'.
Smearing width used when occupations=smearing; heuristic default 0.01 Ry for metals.
Explicit Monkhorst-Pack mesh dimensions (nk1, nk2, nk3); wins outright over k_index/k_distance if more than one is set.
A specific 1-based rung on this structure's own k-mesh ladder (rung 1 is Gamma-only); wins over k_distance if both are set.
Target k-point spacing; heuristic default is 0.15 for metals, 0.30 otherwise.
K-mesh origin offset per axis (0 or 1); defaults to Gamma-centered.
Disable symmetry reduction of the k-point mesh entirely.
Total number of Kohn-Sham bands, overriding the formula-based value entirely.
Extra bands added on top of the formula-computed base band count.
SCF self-consistency energy-convergence threshold; otherwise scaled per atom.
Total-energy convergence threshold between steps; otherwise scaled per atom.
Charge-density mixing parameter for SCF convergence.
Maximum number of SCF iterations allowed before giving up.
SCF density-mixing algorithm; heuristic default is local-TF for 2D/molecule geometries.
Initial SCF iterations that freeze Hubbard occupation-matrix mixing (+U calculations).
HPC queue/partition to submit to.
Number of compute nodes requested; otherwise sized from the estimated memory footprint.
Total number of MPI tasks requested; otherwise nodes x cores_per_node.
Requested job walltime; heuristic default is the partition's own maximum.
HPC accounting/billing code; personal to the submitter, never guessed.
Number of k-point parallelization pools; must divide ntasks evenly.
ScaLAPACK linear-algebra process-grid size; only meaningful when has_scalapack is true.
Ionic relaxation algorithm for relax/vc-relax; vc-relax only accepts 'bfgs' in this codebase (QE couples cell_dynamics to it).
Force-convergence threshold for relax/vc-relax.
Maximum number of ionic/cell relaxation steps.
Maximum BFGS ionic-displacement trust radius (bfgs only).
Minimum BFGS ionic-displacement trust radius; BFGS resets below this (bfgs only).
Initial BFGS ionic-displacement trust radius (bfgs only).
Cancel spurious rigid-body torque for isolated-system relaxation; trades total-energy/force self-consistency for speed.
Fix the bottom N atomic layers of a 2D slab (if_pos) during relax/vc-relax; requires the structure to classify as 2D.
Which cell degrees of freedom vc-relax may move; heuristic default is hexagon-aware for 2D structures ('ibrav+2Dxy' vs bare '2Dxy').
Target external pressure for vc-relax.
Pressure-convergence threshold for vc-relax.
Pseudopotential-table interpolation headroom; must exceed the maximum linear cell contraction expected during vc-relax.

warnings.message: 2D structure in a periodic cell: consider a dipole correction (tefield/dipfield) if the slab is asymmetric along the vacuum direction -- not set automatically here.
ecutrho derived as charge_density_dual x ecutwfc for one or more elements (no explicit value published for that pseudopotential).

Materials Project's U values are calibrated for VASP's PAW projectors; QE's atomic/ortho-atomic/norm-atomic projectors are not guaranteed to give the same effective U for the same physical correction.

No starting_ns_eigenvalue initial occupation-matrix guess is provided (pitfall A10): +U calculations have multiple metastable occupation-matrix solutions and may converge to the wrong one silently. Supplying an explicit initial guess is recommended but not computed automatically here.
the default partition cannot fit the estimated memory footprint even at its node ceiling; a larger-memory partition on the same profile was used instead.
the estimated memory footprint does not fit the default partition even at its node ceiling, and the HPC profile has no larger -memory partition to fall back to.
walltime not specified; requesting the chosen partition's own ceiling instead of a guessed value.
nodes exceeds the chosen partition's own ceiling; the scheduler will likely refuse this request.
walltime_h exceeds the chosen partition's own ceiling; the scheduler will likely refuse this request.
more than one k-sampling convention was given; k_grid wins outright and the others are ignored.
both k_index and k_distance were given; k_index wins outright and k_distance is ignored.
heavy, non-s-block elements are present; consider enabling spin_orbit_coupling (not enabled automatically -- it changes cost and setup).
magnetism could not be determined; defaulted to non-magnetic.
antiferromagnetic ordering was requested but could not be produced; kept ferromagnetic order.
a compensated antiferromagnetic ordering was found and applied; relabeled_structure now differs from structure.
tot_magnetization/starting_magnetization were given but spin_polarized is explicitly false; both are ignored.
nspin=2 doubles the number of k-points QE solves internally, not the number of bands -- nbnd here is per spin channel, unchanged from the non-spin-polarized formula.
noncollinear/spin-orbit bands hold one electron each, not two, so nbnd here is based on the full electron count rather than half of it -- roughly double a comparable non-magnetic run.
occupations='fixed' with a spin-polarized system requires an integer tot_magnetization -- checks.py enforces this, not this advisor.
npool does not divide ntasks; QE will refuse this layout.
npool exceeds the number of reduced k-points; at least one pool will have no k-point to work on.
npool divides ntasks but not the number of reduced k-points evenly; some pools will handle one more k-point than others.
ndiag was given but the code was not built with ScaLAPACK on this profile; QE ignores -ndiag in that case.
ndiag is not a square integer; QE's own default-selection rule always picks one, and a non-square value may be rejected.

cell_dofree='2Dxy' is being used on a non-hexagonal 2D structure; QE's own docs warn the symmetry-preserving 'ibrav+2Dxy' form 'will never converge' for non-hexagonal cells, so the bare '2Dxy' form is used instead, which can silently break exact cell symmetry during relaxation.
a vdW correction method was requested, but the chosen functional already includes dispersion physics; no correction was added to avoid double-counting it.
